creator: Alexander Terp
description: Bundles can now declare post_install steps, which run whenever the bundle is in a profile's resolved set. A profile has no way to skip one: when an upstream bundle's step misbehaves on one machine, the only fix is to stop importing the bundle or patch the source. A per-import option beside `exclude` (for example `skip_post_install: [render]` under a `bundles:` entry) would cover it. Not needed for the first cut; SPEC.md's Post-Install Hooks section explains why (upstream bundles could already ship hooks and scripts the target runs).
title: Let a profile opt out of an imported bundle's post_install step
